data.camera: cowboy shot, standing atop a stone Wall rampart with wind in scarf
data.description: 【三笠 · 城墙巡逻】帕拉迪岛的高墙之上，三笠立于垛口边俯瞰墙内，棕色制服与绿披风在风中猎猎作响，红色围巾在颈间轻轻扬起——「城墙之内，就是我必须守住的答案。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa stands beside the Wall’s stone crenellations and looks down toward the settlement inside. Preserve the brown Survey Corps jacket, white shirt and trousers, green cape, red scarf and ODM harness in the cowboy shot. One crenellation fills the near edge; the walkway continues behind her between repeated parapet blocks, while small roofs far below establish the Wall’s height. Wind lifts the scarf clear of the harness. Daylight strikes the top surfaces of the masonry and the scarf folds; the inner faces of the parapet remain darker, with brief metal reflections on the harness matching the same light direction.
data.title: 三笠 · 城墙巡逻
